name: Trirealm Rift Havocs
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 5 cards from the top of your Deck. You can reveal this card in your hand; banish this card (face-down), and if you do, add 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" cards to your hand, except a Level 5 monster. You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Havocs" once per turn. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can shuffle 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters with the same Attribute as that monster into the Deck, and if you do, negate that activation.
